jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp444_book.1: An old book in a plain dark cover, its spine laced with knotted cord. Every page is covered in a script no one has ever read.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp444_book.2: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-444 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger will bring the book to you, closed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp444_book.3: Readers come to no harm. They only become quieter, and they stay that way.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp444.0: The courier handed it over closed and did not look at the cover.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp444.1: Nobody who opened it has said a word about it since.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.title: The Unknown Script
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.caption: SCP-444 at intake, closed.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.0.text.0: SCP-444 is to be kept closed, in a storage container with a solid door, in a locked room on a quiet corridor. **It is not to be opened for any reason.** Staff moving SCP-444 between containers are to keep the cord tie fastened and their eyes on the floor.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.0.text.1: Personnel designated SCP-444-1 are to be returned to ordinary duties as soon as they are cleared, and are to work alone where they can. Their supervisors are to be told in advance, and are not to take silence for refusal. %rInstances are not to be assigned to radio watch.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.1.text.0: SCP-444 is a small hardbound book of twelve leaves, bound in dark, untreated leather. The boards are not joined by a spine. The gatherings are laced to them with knotted cord, and a toggle of bone on the fore-edge holds the book shut. The cover carries no title or mark of any kind.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.1.text.1: Every page is covered in a handwritten script that matches no known writing system. Analysis has identified sixty-four distinct characters, many of them sharing a common body with small marks above, beside or below it. Notes in a second, smaller hand run up the margins, and diagrams appear throughout. No part of the text has been translated.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.1.text.2: Persons who read SCP-444 are designated SCP-444-1. Instances suffer no injury and show no change in memory, temperament or skill. They remain cooperative and attentive. No instance has been able to describe what they read. %rNo instance has described anything since.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.1.text.3: No treatment attempted to date has had any effect on an instance.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.2.title: Addendum 444-1: Test Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.2.text.0: Test 444-01: a researcher studied the first page of SCP-444 for one minute. Subject designated SCP-444-1. The debrief was brief.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.2.text.1: Test 444-03: a researcher was shown the closed book and asked to describe the cover. No effect.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.2.text.2: Test 444-05: a member of staff was handed SCP-444 open at a diagram and told not to read the text. Subject designated SCP-444-1.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.3.title: Addendum 444-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.3.text: SCP-444 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.
gamerule.scp444Spread.description: When off, SCP-444 only takes hold of those who read it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.444.page.2.text.4: Note 444-08: staff present during an instance's attempts to speak later showed the same symptoms. %rDistance not established.%r
